toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create this NEW standalone complete HTML file (no dependencies) for a polished responsive 30x30 two-snake arcade game. Include all HTML CSS JS inline. Modern dark navy arcade UI with emerald and violet snakes, canvas grid, responsive centered layout, score panels and status, stylish accessible start menu overlay with three mode buttons Human vs Human, CPU vs Human, CPU vs CPU, visible control instructions: P1 WASD, P2 arrow keys; in CPU vs Human the CPU is P1 and human is P2 (arrows). Enter or Space to start highlighted/selected mode, menu buttons clickable, keyboard accessible; after game over Enter/Space restarts same mode, Escape returns to menu; optional on-screen buttons for restart/menu. The game should feel complete, good typography without external font dependency, gradient/glow restrained, high contrast, adaptive sizes. Canvas fixed logical 600x600, 30x30 tiles of 20; scale with CSS, render crisp DPR by using logical canvas scale appropriately (simpler 600x600 intrinsic is fine). Keep request exact: snakes move continuously on timer, four directions, food spawning only in free cells and growth/score on eating; collision with walls or own or rival bodies causes death; simultaneous resolution for two snakes including head-on and head-swap and vacating tails correctly, where both die ends in draw; stop timer at game over, show score and winner. Both snakes start far apart in opposite directions. CPU computes shortest food paths each tick via BFS avoiding walls and occupied snake bodies, then safe direction fallback prioritizing reachable space/tail survival (avoid reversing); two CPUs both seek shared food. Keyboard controls prevent immediate reversal, only accept one turn per snake per tick to prevent rapid self reversal; prevent arrow/space scrolling; ignore controls of CPU players; document key mapping. Speed ~120ms tick; requestAnimationFrame optional for rendering but timer adequate. No external files or libraries. Add semantic accessible labels and live scoreboard. Ensure overlay visibility toggling and buttons do not leak key handlers, game state initializes fresh every new game, no timing duplication, menu visible at load, game-over only when appropriate. Implement fully, not placeholders."}
